title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 24  An Act Transferring the Provincial Capital of Tawi-Tawi From Bato-Bato to Bongao, Amending Section Two of Presidential Decree Numbered three Hundred Two.

text.en:
Section two of Presidential Decree Numbered Three two is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 2. The provincial capital of the province of Tawi-Tawi shall be Bongao."
